content.comment_body: Good morning everyone, I'm working on a project involving [product_name] [article_no] and an HMI panel ([product_name] [product_name]). I have one master [product_name] and one slave [product_name] to increase inputs and outputs. I'm able to assign external tags for the master’s inputs I1 to I24, outputs Q1 to Q16, and flags for alarms within [product_name] [product_name] in [product_name] Basic Portal. How can I assign external tags using network inputs Ni1 to Ni24 and outputs Nq1 to Nq16 for the slave [product_name]? What addresses should be used, and what data type is required in [product_name] Basic Portal? Any advice would be appreciated.
Hello, A [product_name] slave only communicates with its designated master and not directly with the HMI.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to expand their automation setup by linking a master and slave [product_name] device with an HMI panel. The main challenge lies in a lack of clear information on how to address and assign tags for the slave’s network inputs and outputs (Ni1-Ni24/Nq1-Nq16) in [product_name] Basic, as well as understanding valid communication paths between the [product_name] slave and the HMI. This uncertainty risks configuration issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to directly address and assign HMI tags to the slave [product_name]'s network inputs and outputs (Ni1-Ni24, Nq1-Nq16), similar to the master device, and seeks guidance on the correct addresses and data types to use in [product_name] Basic.
